Author: Murali Kalluri
Message:
chore: M6 setup - copy vibe-app to vibe-app-fixed, own Supabase project + ports

Verbatim copy of the M4 baseline (still carries every seeded flaw B-01..B-12

before any fix lands, per PROMPTS.md's M6 workflow - each subsequent commit
applies exactly one of these prompts.

Description: A key whose name contains 'secret' is assigned a bare string literal instead of an environment-variable reference
Author: Murali Kalluri
Message:
feat: M4 - Target B (vibe-app) baseline, closes B-01..B-12

StudioBook (fictional): Next.js 14 + local Supabase + Stripe app with all
12 seeded findings B-01..B-12 live and reproducible via exploits/*.sh
against a freshly `supabase db reset` stack.

Fixes applied after milestone-reviewer's FAIL report:
- package.json dev/start now bind to VIBE_APP_HOST_PORT (8187) instead of
  Next's default 3000, so every documented exploit script can connect.
- Closed an unlisted privilege-escalation hole: Supabase's default ACLs
  grant every new table a blanket table-level UPDATE to `authenticated`,
  which let any member self-promote to admin and set their own
  credit_balance via a raw PostgREST PATCH. Revoked the blanket grant and
  restricted it to profile-editing columns only; credit_balance and role
  are now only ever written server-side via the service-role client
  (app/api/bookings, app/api/admin/grant-credits), which is where B-06 and
  B-10 actually live.
- Added app/studio/dashboard/page.tsx, the ~600-line, no-shared-data-layer,
  triple-duplicated-pricing-formula page B-12 describes (previously only
  partially seeded).
- Webhook credits metadata now coerced with Number() to match Stripe's
  real string-typed metadata shape; Stripe checkout success/cancel URLs
  derived from the request origin instead of a hardcoded localhost:8187.
- Minor doc/script accuracy fixes (B-09 upsert header, stale fixture
  comment, missing module .gitignore, *.tsbuildinfo untracked).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Spring `${VAR:literal}` default value on a password/secret-named property ships that literal as the real credential whenever the env var is unset
Author: Murali Kalluri
Message:
feat: M1 - Target A baseline with seeded flaws A-01..A-13 + exploits

tenant-api (LedgerLite) baseline: Postgres/Flyway schema, Keycloak realm
(2 fictional tenants x 4 roles), JWT resource server, and all 13 seeded
vulnerabilities from SPEC.md section 2 (A-01 BOLA invoice read, A-02 BOLA
customer update, A-03 mass-assignment/BOPLA, A-04 tenant header spoof,
A-05 sequential export id leak, A-06 tenant-agnostic dashboard cache,
A-07 BFLA invite, A-08 JWT audience/lifetime/refresh, A-09 secrets in
application.yml, A-10 no rate limiting, A-11 no audit + tokens in logs,
A-12 SQL injection via sort, A-13 SSRF via webhook test).

One curl exploit script per finding in targets/tenant-api/exploits/, all
verified live against a running docker compose stack. Added a Testcontainers
+ spring-security-test integration suite for the isolation-relevant flaws.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
